business_meaning: Unique number of a purchase request after duplicate order IDs are removed.
Account that placed the order. Links to stg_customers.customer_id.
allowed_values_or_range: Positive ID. It should exist in stg_customers; the source contains orphan references.

business_meaning: Date the order was placed. A missing or unparseable source date becomes NULL.
allowed_values_or_range: Expected: valid date not after the reporting date. The source has 11 missing dates and future dates.

business_meaning: Current order state, lower-cased and trimmed, with canceled changed to cancelled.
Sales channel used to place the order.
Country where the order is sent, linked to the customer through the order.
Order total including VAT and shipping, before refunds. Used as gross_revenue_eur.
allowed_values_or_range: Expected: greater than 0. The source has 6 zero or negative totals, including -49.90.

business_meaning: Unique number of a payment record with captured or refunded status.
Order linked to the payment record. Several records may exist per order, but the supplied file has one per order.
allowed_values_or_range: Positive ID that exists in stg_orders.order_id. Repeated IDs are allowed.

business_meaning: Payment date supplied by the provider. The field does not identify a separate refund date.
allowed_values_or_range: Expected: valid date on or after the order date and not after the reporting date. Some source payment dates precede their order.

business_meaning: Payment method used for this record.
Positive payment or refund amount in euros. payment_status tells whether the amount was captured or refunded.
allowed_values_or_range: Greater than 0. Refund amounts stay positive and are subtracted when calculating net revenue.

business_meaning: Last four card digits as text. This is not a full card number and can be missing.
unit_or_format: Four digits as text; keep leading zeros
allowed_values_or_range: NULL or exactly 4 digits (0000 to 9999). The source has missing card values and values on non-card payments.

business_meaning: Current payment record state, renamed from the raw status column.
